Subject: QBR deck readiness: account snapshots + consolidation checklist

Folks —

We have the QBR executive review scheduled for 2026-06-10. I want to consolidate a single slide deck that contains:
- A one-slide account snapshot for each named account (health, ARR, risks, next steps)
- A two-row pipeline forecast rollup (Committed / Best Case) and any movement since last QBR
- Clear owners for any open actions or blockers to close in the next 30 days

Please see attached QBR_template_v3.pptx (slide placeholders + export notes). Action items:
- Marissa: account snapshots for Acme Corp and Vector Analytics — 1 slide each, include renewal horizon and top 3 risks
- Laura: consolidated forecast table + note on tempo changes (beats, misses) across top 10 accounts
- Vivek: pull and confirm ARR / seat counts from billing export; flag any data discrepancies

Can we get first drafts by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-03)? If you anticipate pushback, call me today and we’ll re-prioritize. I’ll own final slide assembly and corporate notes.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Karthik —

Thanks for the template. Draft account snapshots attached for Acme and Vector. High level:

Acme Corp (owner: Marissa)
- ARR: $1.2M (renewal Jan 2027)
- Current health: Moderate (3 escalations in last 60 days around latency/SLAs but working through mitigations)
- Risks: billing reconciliation outstanding; potential procurement re-org (contact: Olivia Chen)
- Next steps: 1) finalize billing memos by 6/7, 2) schedule technical deep-dive with infra on 6/9

Vector Analytics (owner: Marissa)
- ARR: $480k (expansion motion in flight for embedding search add-on)
- Health: Good (weekly touchpoints, low error rates)
- Risks: exec sponsor change — need to confirm priority by EOW
- Next steps: close expansion POC (Raj Patel) and confirm seat counts by 6/8

Attachments: Acme_account_onepager.pdf (1 page summary), vector_run_rates.xlsx (run rate sheet)

I left comments on the template where we should call out known regressions and the action owner column. Will update if Laura needs different formatting.

—Marissa

Karthik / Marissa —

Attached is a compact forecast rollup (see sheet 1). Quick summary for the deck:
- Total committed ARR (top 12): $7.9M (down $320k QoQ driven by two renewals pushed to H2)
- Best case pipeline: $12.6M (includes $2.1M of at-risk but active negotiation)
- Variance drivers: Acme moved $300k from committed to best-case pending procurement signoff; Nimbus Health shows improved expansion velocity (+$140k)
- Ask: For any account where you have a change >$50k, add an abbreviated note in the template under "Forecast delta"

I pulled the historic win rates by segment and added a suggested confidence band (Committed = 85%+, Best Case = 40–60%). If we need to be conservative for exec review, I can present the committed-only view.

Also tagging the Acme contact from Marissa to confirm the billing item—Marissa, please loop Olivia if you haven't already.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

If helpful, I can join a 15-min alignment call on 6/08 at 11am PT.

Best,
